# Ko-fi, Patreon and Streamlabs

Tips and memberships through outside services, shown as alerts and counted on the support bar. They make nobody a supporter here: the site's supporter perks come from a Stripe subscription or a gift sub.

Choose it during setup on the **Modules** page; its setup page then appears with the steps below. The same steps are in the Admin Panel later.

The addresses below are for a site at `example.com`; your setup page shows your own.

## 1. Ko-fi (optional)

Ko-fi → Settings → API → Webhook URL: paste the address below, then copy the verification token Ko-fi shows into this page.

Links:

- [Ko-fi: webhooks](https://ko-fi.com/manage/webhooks)

Copy into the provider's page:

| What | Value |
|---|---|
| Webhook URL | `https://api.example.com/webhook/kofi` |

This step fills:

- **Ko-fi verification token** (kept encrypted). Verifies that a Ko-fi donation webhook is real.

You can skip this step and come back to it from the Admin Panel.

## 2. Patreon (optional)

Patreon → the developer portal → My Webhooks: add the address below for member events, then copy the webhook secret into this page.

Links:

- [Patreon: webhooks](https://www.patreon.com/portal/registration/register-webhooks)

Copy into the provider's page:

| What | Value |
|---|---|
| Webhook URL | `https://api.example.com/webhook/patreon` |

This step fills:

- **Patreon webhook secret** (kept encrypted). Verifies that a Patreon pledge webhook is real.

You can skip this step and come back to it from the Admin Panel.

## 3. Streamlabs (optional)

Streamlabs → Settings → API Settings → API Tokens: copy the Socket API token into this page. It applies when the chat service restarts.

Links:

- [Streamlabs: API settings](https://streamlabs.com/dashboard#/settings/api-settings)

This step fills:

- **Streamlabs socket token** (kept encrypted). The Streamlabs donation feed.

You can skip this step and come back to it from the Admin Panel.
